messages:
clare: FYI we started a 2% canary for coalescer-compaction v2 + kv-prefetch tuning this morning. Primary goal was to reduce fragmentation on short bursts and lower per-token CPU/GPU overhead.
ryan: Ran a 72h replay from our production sample. High-level: p50 -16%, p95 -7%, p99 -21%. Overall token cost down ~9.3% vs baseline. Biggest wins on seq<=56 flows.
dev-bot: Canary artifact: https://internal.redwood/bench/2849123456. Quick snapshot (shard-mean):
```
- baseline p50 29ms -> canary p50 24.5ms (-16%)
- baseline p95 145ms -> canary p95 134.8ms (-7%)
- baseline p99 455ms -> canary p99 360ms (-21%)
- cost/1k tokens: $0.080 -> $0.0726 (-9.3%)
- 5xx rate: 0.06% -> 0.065% (statistically noise)
```
sofia: Nice. Any host or GPU memory drift? Queueing behavior?
ryan: No persistent GPU mem growth across shards. Saw a transient coalescer queue spike on shard-3 for ~90s during ramp which correlated with a bad traffic slice; auto-fallback routed that shard to the stable kernel and no customer-visible errors.
clare: Canary safety rules we used (copied for the rollout doc):
```
canary:
  pct: 2
  ramp: 2 -> 20 over 45m -> 100 over 3h
  eval_window: 12m
  rollback_triggers:
    p99_rel_increase_pct: 12
    error_rate_abs_increase_pct: 0.5
    sustained_gpu_mem_growth_mb: 55
    coalescer_queue_tail_ms: 70
```
product: Can product ops get one short line for the weekly customer note? Prefer non-technical wording.
clare: Suggested customer blurb: "Runtime tuning reduced typical response time by ~16% and high-percentile latency by ~21% for common short-turn chats; estimated token cost savings ~9%."
sofia: We also added a sequence-length heatmap and a compact-kernel matchup chart to the artifact so folks can see where the wins are. I'll attach an A/B table showing per-route improvements and the fallback counts.
ryan: Two technical notes: 1) coalescer-compaction v2 packs across short gaps more aggressively which increases packing density but required us to slightly increase small-window backoff to avoid transient queueing. 2) kv-prefetch tuning raised prefix TTL for hot keys by 20% which lifted hit-rate ~8.4%.
clare: Monitoring hooks bound to runtime.coalescer.compaction, runtime.kv.prefetch, gpu.memory.delta and runtime.routing.fallbacks. PagerDuty on for 2h. If no triggers fire we plan to ramp to 25% in 1h and finish roll by EOD.
product: Thanks 95 that's perfect — we'll include the blurb and link the heatmap in the weekly notes.
ryan: I'll follow up with a short doc on the compact-kernel heuristics and the fallback policy. Good job team! :rocket:
